title: Preselect a company from a deep link
preconditions: The directory is open and at least one company has records.

steps.expected: The company filter is preselected as 'Acko Tech' and only that company's records are listed.
The same company remains selected and the same records are shown.

risk: Read-only. The company value must exist in the seeded data; substitute another seeded company if it does not.
